lifecycle: research-only: DISCOVERED -> EVALUATING -> VALIDATED/REJECTED by governance. None of these are production rules.

hypotheses.definition: High liquidity confluence (>2) is followed by LOWER volatility and LOWER directional magnitude than low confluence.
hypotheses.effect: mean abs move 1.12 (high) vs 1.68 (low) ATR at H5; vol ratio 2.32 vs 2.94
hypotheses.note: Do NOT convert to a rule (e.g. 'avoid high confluence'). Could be a calm-structure artifact.

hypotheses.definition: Liquidity sweep state carries volatility/activity information but NOT directional information (no reversal/continuation edge).
hypotheses.sample: n=785 positive sweep, n=214 negative (zero n=1 LOW_EVIDENCE)
hypotheses.effect: reversal prob ~0.68 (H5) / ~0.80 (H15) for both directions; abs move nearly identical
hypotheses.confidence: MODERATE (consistent across horizons, but no directional separation)
hypotheses.note: Sweep may HELP as a volatility/regime gate, not as a direction signal.

hypotheses.definition: Price FAR from liquidity (far distance bins) trends/extends more than price NEAR liquidity.
hypotheses.effect: abs move 2.58 (far) vs 2.19 (near) ATR at H15; monotone across bins

hypotheses.definition: HTF liquidity score sign does NOT dominate the 70D signal (positive vs negative similar forward outcomes).
hypotheses.effect: abs move 2.20 vs 2.41 ATR at H15; no meaningful separation

hypotheses.definition: liquidity-v1.1 (TASK-06) resolves the v1.0 degeneracies (confluence saturation, sweep flood, eqh step) and is therefore the correct version for any model-level evaluation.
hypotheses.effect: confluence unique 2->225, saturation 0.9975->0.4325; eqh std 0.14->0.18; sweep 65% of rows changed
hypotheses.confidence: HIGH (distributional evidence; model-level verdict still required)
hypotheses.oos_evidence: TASK-4 benchmark protocol pending model training
hypotheses.note: This is a VERSION decision, not a trading rule — mission 43 isolation.

global_notes: All event-study results are exploratory (multiple testing: 45+ feature/outcome dimensions; corrections needed before confirmatory claims — mission 35).
No hypothesis has been converted to a strategy/parameter change (mission 26/47).
